rows.label: Warm model and pipelines, fresh uncached prompts, final K=4/flush-32 stack under sustained background CPU load
rows.statistic: Median of six rotating paired observations; each observation resets KV state and uses a different prompt.

pairedSpeedup.baseline: published WebLLM 0.2.84 runtime and subgroup-32 model library, one-step sampler
pairedSpeedup.candidate: local subgroup-32/chunk-256/TR=32 model library, K=4, one compute pass, submit every 32 dispatches

quality.freshPromptExact: 6/6 tuned outputs byte-identical to the paired published path with equal completion-token counts
quality.qualityCorpusExact: 4/4 tuned outputs byte-identical to the paired published path

rows.notes: 13.541 ms/token is the reciprocal of the measured 73.85 tokens/s median. The paired 1.285x statistic is the median of per-round ratios and need not equal the ratio of independent medians.

publishedBaseUnderLoadSmoke.notes: Single warm smoke, recorded for completeness; not the paired baseline.

publishedSubgroup32UnderLoad.notes: Paired six-round published WebLLM 0.2.84 subgroup-32 baseline under sustained background CPU load.

caveat: Absolute measured throughput was taken while unrelated work saturated the CPU. The paired ratio is the robust headline. There is no historical quiet 4B number and no quiet projection is claimed.
